Audit the plan you inherited

The app arrives already instrumented. Somebody set it up in a hurry, and the plan has problems in it — wrong names, missing context, properties that can't answer the question they were added for, and a couple of things that are fine as they are. Your job is to work out which is which.

Write your own event name for each action before you read the middle column, then note what's wrong with what shipped. You don't need an event for every action.

User properties as shipped

The app sends role, analytics_experience, last_task_id, last_filter with the Identify call. Decide which of those describe the person, which describe the latest action and belong on an event instead, and what's missing.

Station 1 · 12 min

Audit the event names

  1. Read the action inventory and the question each event is supposed to answer.
  2. Before you open the app, write the event name you would use for each action.
  3. Now open the app's Instrumentation panel and compare your names with the plan it shipped with.
  4. Fix the names in the app, and untick any action you decided not to track at all.

Done when: The app's event names match a plan you would defend, and anything you chose not to track is unticked.

Station 2 · 12 min

Fix the properties

  1. Work through the property chips on each event in the app.
  2. Tick the context that event's question actually needs, and untick what you can't justify.
  3. Fix any property whose type is wrong.
  4. Sort out the user properties: person context on the person, occurrence context on the event.
  5. Record a type and an example for every property you keep.

Done when: Each event carries the context its question needs and nothing it can't justify, and person context sits on the user rather than on every event.

Station 3 · 8 min

Connect Amplitude

  1. Create a blank Amplitude project.
  2. Open the app's Connection panel.
  3. Paste the project API key and select its region.
  4. Leave Session Replay ticked, and add a Web Experiment deployment key only if you have one.
  5. Connect, complete your profile, and send user properties.
  6. Read the Wire entries in the Activity panel: that's what left the browser, replay ID and session included.

Done when: The app shows Connected and the Activity panel records an Identify call.

Station 4 · 12 min

Generate and verify events

  1. Perform at least three different actions.
  2. Compare each Activity payload with the plan.
  3. Search Amplitude for the generated analyst ID.
  4. Confirm event names, property names, and property types.

Done when: At least three event types appear in Amplitude with the event and property names you planned.

If an event is missing: check the app response, browser network request, ad blocker, API key, and US/EU region in that order.

Station 5 · 6 min · optional

Ask one question

  1. Choose one question from the plan.
  2. Build an Event Segmentation or Funnel chart.
  3. State what the workshop-sized sample can't support.

Done when: A chart answers one question from your plan and its limitation is written down.

Reference user properties

  • role · string · example: digital analyst
  • analytics_experience · string · example: intermediate
  • workshop_table · string · example: table-4

Task text is deliberately absent. Task length supports the exercise questions without collecting the content a person typed.

Counting conventions

  • list_size is measured after the change, so a create counts the new task and a delete excludes the removed one.
  • task_position is the position in the list as displayed, so it reflects what the person actually clicked when a filter is active.
  • entry_method distinguishes pressing Enter in the field from clicking Add task.

Recovery

  • Notes disappeared: they're kept in this browser on this device, so a different browser, a private window, or cleared site data starts you blank. Use Copy my notes to take them with you.
  • No project permission: pair with someone who can create a project and use different generated user IDs.
  • SDK won't load: disable the ad blocker for the workshop page or pair with another attendee.
  • Session Replay didn't attach: the Activity panel says so and analytics carries on regardless. Blockers stop the replay plugin more often than the analytics SDK. Replays also take a few minutes to appear, and need a session with some activity in it.
  • Web Experiment was rejected: that key needs to be a client-side deployment key from this project. Leave the field empty if you don't have one — nothing else depends on it.
  • Connected to the wrong region: disconnect, choose the project's US or EU region, and reconnect.
  • Events haven't appeared: use the generated user ID in User Lookup and wait briefly before changing anything.
